instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD (CompositeResourceDefinition)
How to create a Crossplane XRD with a nested field
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
              replicas:
                type: integer'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition
How to create a Crossplane Composition with a patch
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
  resources:
  - name: my-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
    patches:
    - fromFieldPath: spec.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane claim
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: MyApp
metadata:
  name: my-app-claim
spec:
  region: us-east-1
  replicas: 2
  compositionRef:
    name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
  resourceRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
    name: my-app-claim'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane claim with a composition selector
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: MyApp
metadata:
  name: my-app-claim
spec:
  region: us-east-1
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      provider: aws'
